about: Pieces of art for the website. styles hold the words every piece of a kind shares; fix holds pixfix settings per style (a piece's own fix overrides). heroes expands into one sprite per race and class the game allows. Scenes and panoramas use one fixed pixel size each (the drawings' own pixels drift too much to detect); heroes are scaled so that hero_height art pixels is a race at 100% height, making every race the right size next to the others and in the scenes.
constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no user interface, no named characters, no signature.

frame.asset: website UI panel frame (9-slice border source), source art for pixel-art cleanup
frame.medium: authentic pixel art drawn on a 64x64 logical pixel grid and upscaled with nearest-neighbor, so every logical pixel is a crisp, equal-sized square block on one uniform grid; hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; limited palette of about 16 colors; light from the top left; 1-pixel dark outline.
frame.framing: one complete square frame seen straight on, perfectly symmetric left-right and top-bottom, the four corners identical (rotated); ornaments only in the corners; the four straight edges plain and uniform between the corners so the middle of each edge can be repeated to any length; the border is about 12% of the width; the empty inside of the frame is one flat solid near-black color #120e0a with nothing in it.
frame.backdrop: outside the frame, perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta background, one uniform color right up to the outline, no shadow, no texture, no lighting variation. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere in the subject.

scene.asset: wide illustration for a website list row (a combat test), source art for pixel-art cleanup
scene.medium: detailed modern hi-bit pixel art (in the spirit of Octopath Traveler or Sea of Stars) drawn on a fine logical pixel grid and upscaled with nearest-neighbor, every logical pixel a crisp equal-sized square block; hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur; rich but limited palette of about 32 colors; atmospheric lighting; faithful to the look of classic World of Warcraft (2004 to 2006): its painterly colors, chunky stylized proportions and recognizable places.
scene.framing: a wide side-view scene like a 2D game screen; the ground is flat and open along the bottom of the picture; on the left third of the picture the flat ground reaches down to the bottom edge and nothing stands there, because the player's hero will be placed there later; the enemies stand on the same ground in the right half, facing left. scene.backdrop: the full scene edge to edge, no border.

human.desc: a Human of Stormwind: tall and broad-shouldered, fair skin, short brown hair and a trimmed beard or neat hair

dwarf.desc: a Dwarf of Ironforge: short and very stocky with thick arms, ruddy skin, a huge braided red or brown beard

night_elf.desc: a Night Elf of Darnassus: very tall and lean, lavender-purple skin, very long swept-back ears, glowing silver eyes, long teal hair

gnome.desc: a Gnome of Gnomeregan: tiny with an oversized head, big ears and nose, large round eyes, wild bright teal hair in a tall tuft

high_order.desc: a Skyborne elf of the High Order (the new elven race of World of Warcraft: Forever, descended from the Highborne): tall and slender like a high elf, fair skin, long pointed ears, white and pale-gold feathers braided into long silver hair, faint sky-blue tattoos on the face, colors of white, gold and sky blue

orc.desc: an Orc of Orgrimmar: huge muscular green-skinned brute with jutting lower tusks, a black topknot, hunched powerful shoulders

undead.desc: a Forsaken undead: gaunt decayed body with grey-green rotting skin, bare bone showing at the jaw and forearms, glowing yellow eyes, lank black hair

tauren.desc: a Tauren of Thunder Bluff: an enormous bull-like humanoid with brown fur, large curved horns, a broad muzzle with a nose ring, hooves and a braided mane

troll.desc: a Darkspear Troll: tall and lanky with blue skin, huge upward-curving tusks, a tall red mohawk, long pointed ears, a slouched stance and two-toed feet

windshaper.desc: a Skyborne elf of the Windshapers (the new elven race of World of Warcraft: Forever, descended from the Highborne): tall and slender like a high elf, sun-tanned skin, long pointed ears, teal and bronze feathers braided into long dark hair, swirling wind tattoos, colors of teal, bronze and deep blue

classes.warrior: a Warrior in heavy plate armor with oversized spiked pauldrons and a tabard, holding a huge two-handed sword ready
classes.paladin: a Paladin in shining silver plate armor with gold trim and big rounded pauldrons, holding a two-handed warhammer, a faint golden holy glow
classes.hunter: a Hunter in mail and leather armor with a quiver on the back, holding a longbow drawn (a rifle for a dwarf), with a loyal wolf pet at their side
classes.rogue: a Rogue in dark fitted leather armor with a hood and a cloth face mask, crouched low, holding two daggers
classes.priest: a Priest in long flowing white and gold cloth robes with a high collar, holding a staff, a soft holy light glowing in one hand
classes.shaman: a Shaman in mail armor with tribal totem motifs and spiked shoulder guards, holding a mace and a round wooden shield, crackling blue lightning around one hand
classes.mage: a Mage in long blue and silver cloth robes with a tall collar, holding a crystal-topped staff, a swirl of frost magic in the other hand
classes.warlock: a Warlock in dark purple and black cloth robes with horned skull shoulder pads, holding a staff, green fel fire in one hand, with a small red imp companion at their feet
classes.druid: a Druid in leather armor with leaf, antler and feather details, holding a gnarled wooden staff topped with leaves, a faint green nature glow
